detailed_descriptions_html.en:
THAT’S NOT LUCK.

Blackjack, horse racing, dice, roulette, and slots. Everyone’s trying to win. One player already knows how.

As the Cheater, use your glasses to reveal the next winning bet. Try to look surprised when it pays out.

SECURITY HAS A SHOTGUN

One player is the Security Guard. Watch the bets, study the players, and work out who’s cheating.
Your job ends when you shoot the Cheater. Preferably after some actual detective work.

EVERY WIN LEAVES A TRACE.

The Guard’s Casino Trace scanner watches the whole floor live. Every win shows up the moment it pays out.

It tells you where. Figuring out who is still your job.

SOME PEOPLE PLAY TO LOSE

Add the optional Robber and Jester roles for more suspicious behaviour

  • The Robber can steal 40% of another player’s money.

  • The Jester wins by losing every chip.

Neither wants the Guard confirming their identity.

TONY WOULD LIKE HIS MONEY BACK

Running low? Visit Tony for a task and a loan. Just remember the interest.
His guards will come to collect, and they’re happy to make it personal.

BAD INFLUENCES WELCOME

  • Throw bottles

  • Pop flashbangs

  • Fill the room with smoke

  • Make it rain with the Money Gun

  • Consume questionable gummies

THE ONLY HONEST TABLE.

Need a break from all the lying? Grab a cue in the lounge for a round of 8-ball with real pool physics, 1v1 or 2v2 with your friends.

Nobody’s cheating here. Probably.

SO, WHO’S CHEATING?

  • Up to 8 players online

  • Roles: Innocent Gamblers, the Cheater and the Security Guard, plus the optional Robber and Jester.

  • Proximity voice chat for lying to each other’s faces.

Everyone’s a suspect. Everyone has an excuse.
